name: Rhodiola rosea extract
description: Rhodiola rosea extract (CAS 97404-52-9 ) is a standardized botanical extract derived from the root of Rhodiola rosea, a flowering plant native to cold mountain regions. Commercially supplied in forms standardized to active marker compounds, it is sourced by formulators across nutraceutical, pharmaceutical, and cosmetic supply chains as an adaptogenic ingredient. In dietary supplement manufacturing, it is incorporated into capsules, tablets, and functional beverages targeting stress resilience and cognitive performance positioning for various consumer markets. Pharmaceutical and nutraceutical formulators use it in standardized herbal preparations where consistent rosavins and salidroside content is required for label claims and regulatory compliance. In personal care, it is used in anti-aging and skin-protective formulations where antioxidant activity supports product efficacy positioning within the global cosmetic industry. Functional food and sports nutrition brands also incorporate it into powder blends and energy formats targeting endurance and recovery claims for professional and amateur athletes. Rhodiola rosea extract is available as a fine powder, suitable for direct encapsulation, blending, or tableting. Standard commercial grades are typically standardized to 3% rosavins. Higher-concentration specifications are available for pharmaceutical-grade applications.
